parts.text: Caroline was researching adoption agencies as part of her goal to become a single mom. She was specifically looking for LGBTQ+-inclusive agencies — she chose one that supports LGBTQ+ individuals because their inclusivity and support really spoke to her. That research was the lead-up to applying back in August and passing her adoption agency interviews last Friday (October 17), which she shared with Melanie on this very day.
